issues.title: Ingest Nevada County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $7,597,588 across 26 funds. The largest: County General Fund ($2,460,316), Road & Bridge ($2,191,175), Solid Waste ($1,014,350). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Reconcile County General Fund
issues.detail: Printed total is $2,460,315.56; the departments listed add to $2,458,289.56. The page image shows these numbers; the $2,026.00 gap is not explained on the page. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
